_om: Kassetten in English (Rewind, rusj.no/en/rewind/) – say a word, hear it backwards, copy it. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Words and sentences are in data.en/kassett.json, written for the UK.
Mikrofonen ble ikke tillatt. Trykk «Till: The microphone wasn't allowed. Tap ‘Allow’ when your phone asks, or turn on the microphone for your browser in Settings.
Mikrofonen virker ikke inne i denne appe: The microphone doesn't work inside this app. Open rusj.no in Safari or Chrome.
Denne nettleseren gir ikke tilgang til m: This browser doesn't give access to the microphone. Try Safari or Chrome.
Jeg hørte ingenting. Hold mobilen nær mu: I didn't hear anything. Hold the phone close to your mouth and try again.
Topp fem av {n}. Hele lista kommer på sl: Top five of {n}. The full list comes at the end.
Én sier et hemmelig ord inn i mobilen. M: One player says a secret word into the phone. The phone plays it backwards – and the next player has to copy the sound. Play the copy backwards and the word comes back. Or something completely different!
Fortelleren ser ordet, trykker «Ta opp»: The teller sees the word, taps ‘Record’ and says it clearly. The phone plays it backwards.
Hermeren hører baklengs-lyden så mange g: The copier listens to the backwards sound as many times as they like, and copies it as closely as they can.
Mobilen spiller hermingen baklengs. Gjet: The phone plays the copy backwards. Guess what it was – then the word is shown.
Helt likt gir 2 poeng, nesten gir 1 poen: Spot on gives 2 points, close gives 1 point. Both players get the points. Most points at the end wins.
Hold mobilen nær munnen og si ordet lang: Hold the phone close to your mouth and say the word slowly and clearly.
«Sakte» gjør baklengs-lyden lettere å he: ‘Slow’ makes the backwards sound easier to copy.
Lyden blir på mobilen. Den sendes ingen: The sound stays on the phone. It is never sent anywhere and is deleted after every turn.
Trykket dere feil? «Angre» tar poengene: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the points back.
Si et ord, hør det baklengs – og herm så: Say a word, hear it backwards – then copy it as best you can.
Blir det ordet igjen?: Will it be the word again?
The microphone rarely works inside apps. Open rusj.no in Safari or Chrome to play.
To og to spiller sammen: én sier ordet,: Players take turns in pairs: one says the word, the next copies it.
Spillet bruker mikrofonen. Lyden blir på: The game uses the microphone. The sound stays on the phone and is deleted after every turn.
Gi mobilen til fortelleren: Pass the phone to the teller
Slik høres det ut baklengs:: This is how it sounds backwards:
Trykk, si det tydelig, og trykk igjen nå: Tap, say it clearly, and tap again when you're done.
Lytt til baklengs-lyden, og herm den så: Listen to the backwards sound and copy it as closely as you can.
Hør hermingen baklengs – og gjett!: Hear the copy backwards – and guess!
Ingen ord kom tilbake. Baklengs er vansk: No words came back. Backwards is hard!
Whoever has the most points so far wins.
